W.note: Fallstreak hole with ice streaks and the cold contrail line is accurate and fresh; counts 5 (Round gap in the sheet) / 7 (streaks of ice falling below) / 5 (the plane's line gone cold).

X.note: Nacreous clouds before dawn are evoked accurately but 'mother-of-pearl' is the stock epithet; counts 5 (Na-cre-ous glow burns) / 7 / 5 (moth-er-of-pearl sky).

Y.note: Noctilucent clouds holding the last light then fading to plain sky, with a good turn; counts 5 (Night-shin-ing streaks hold) / 7 (the last blue-white of the day) / 5 (then grey, then just sky).

Z.note: Nacreous clouds named but the lines are abstract and stock; counts 5 (Moth-er-of-pearl sheets) / 7 (na-cre-ous light on cold air) / 5 (dawn the sky holds, brief).
